characterList.description: A bright blue dog with dark blue spots. Speaks for the first time.
characterList.name: Blue

characterList.description: A human man with brown hair, often wearing colorful sweaters. Interacts with Blue and other puppets.
characterList.name: Joe

characterList.description: A light purple dog with darker purple spots. Friend of Blue.
characterList.name: Magenta

characterList.description: A light green cat with darker green stripes. Another friend of Blue.
characterList.name: Periwinkle

characterList.description: A purple dresser drawer with googly eyes and a mouth. Often provides props.
characterList.name: Sidetable Drawer

characterList.description: A red mailbox with googly eyes and a mouth. Often delivers mail.
characterList.name: Mailbox

characterList.description: A clock with a happy face, hands, and feet. Helps keep track of time.
characterList.name: Tickety Tock

characterList.description: A green bar of soap with googly eyes and a mouth. Often appears during bath time.
characterList.name: Slippery Soap

characterList.description: A red shovel and a yellow pail with googly eyes and mouths. Used for playing in the sandbox.
characterList.name: Shovel & Pail

characterList.description: A pair of salt and pepper shakers with googly eyes and mouths. Often appear during mealtime.
characterList.name: Mr. Salt & Mrs. Pepper

characterList.description: A red jukebox with googly eyes, a mouth, and a disco ball. Plays music.
characterList.name: Boogie Woogie

characterList.description: A small green puppy with darker green spots. Is a friend of Blue.
characterList.name: Green Puppy

characterList.description: A gingerbread man with red and white striped clothes, big red shoes, a red cap, and rosy cheeks. A Candy Land inhabitant.
characterList.name: Mr. Mint

characterList.description: A gingerbread man with a green backpack, rosy cheeks, and big eyes. He is on a quest to reach King Candy's castle.
characterList.name: Jib

characterList.description: A princess with red hair tied in a ponytail with a crown, a purple dress, and fairy wings. She helps Jib in Candy Land.
characterList.name: Princess Lolly

characterList.description: A plump woman with brown hair tucked under a green hat, an orange dress, a yellow apron, and peanut earrings. She gives Jib advice in Candy Land.
characterList.name: Grandma Nut

characterList.description: A round man with a white beard, a purple robe, a red and yellow striped shirt, red shoes, and a crown with candy details. He is the ruler of Candy Land.
characterList.name: King Kandy

characterList.description: A blonde princess with a pink dress, a red cape, and ice skates. She lives in the Ice Cream Sea in Candy Land.
characterList.name: Princess Frostine

characterList.description: A black penguin with red cheeks and a blue train conductor outfit. He is a Weeble.
characterList.name: Pendleton

characterList.description: A yellow chick with rosy cheeks and a blue outfit. She is a Weeble.
characterList.name: Zuzie Q

characterList.description: A purple elephant with pink ears and a pink outfit. She is a Weeble.
characterList.name: Tibby

characterList.description: A purple cow with yellow horns and a yellow and pink outfit. He is a Weeble.
characterList.name: Diddy

characterList.description: A green turtle with rosy cheeks and a red firefighter outfit. He is a Weeble.
characterList.name: Tooey
